## Pre-Submission Checklist

- [ ] I have read the SPEC-KIT.md
- [ ] This feature is not already specified
- [ ] This feature stays within segment boundaries

## Segment

Which segment would this feature belong to?

- [ ] OAS (Onboard Autonomy)
- [ ] GSC (Ground Simulation)
- [ ] MCWI (Mission Control Web Interface)
- [ ] shared-contracts
- [ ] Documentation

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Educational Value

How does this feature help learners understand autonomous systems?

## Problem it Solves

What problem or gap does this address?

## Proposed Implementation

If you have ideas on how to implement this, share them here.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Any other relevant information, mockups, or examples.
